example.title: State Theatre, Traverse City (rebuilt 1949, restored 2007)
example.place: Traverse City, Grand Traverse County, MI

brief: A cinema front with a big neon vertical sign and a lit marquee, a red-panelled facade with 'State' in giant letters. Two photos. Older than 1970: Petoskey's Gaslight District (the town's model) is a row of 1880-1910 brick commercial blocks; no newer example of this main-street type exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
